(2) Suddenly, a sharp, high-pitched feminine greeting interrupts the gossip, accompanied by a bright comedic sound effect. (3) The audio shifts into hyper-energetic, fast-paced laughter and overlapping voices, with upbeat synth-pop BGM swelling in the background. (4) The voices maintain an exaggeratedly polite and high-pitched tone as they exchange goodbyes. (5) After a short pause, the high-pitched feminine voice returns with a mocking, sarcastic tone, followed by a series of sharp, rhythmic laughs.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously satirize 'fake friendships' or superficial social interactions where people act overly friendly in person while harboring negative feelings behind each other's backs.
